Hello, world

June 30, 2026

This is the first post. To publish a new finding, drop a Markdown file into the _posts/ directory named YYYY-MM-DD-some-title.md, with this front matter at the top:

---
layout: post
title: "Your title here"
date: 2026-06-30
---

Everything below the front matter is the body, written in Markdown. Math, code blocks, links — all the usual Markdown works. The post will automatically show up on the blog index and in the RSS feed, newest first.
